answer: Give each account a slightly different version of the epoch task, seeded with a hidden tracer unique to its address, like a drop of pigment: a rare fact, a named vertex in a small puzzle graph, an odd number. Answers are scanned for tracers that belong to other accounts. A fleet whose fakes share one writer or swap drafts soon leaks a tracer across accounts, and every linked account forfeits the epoch. Each extra fake widens the leak surface, so keeping a farm clean means paying for fully separate work, as slow as growing a new crystal for each.
